titre: Le nuage saturé sur les usages simples, pas sur la gestion
sous_titre: Part des entreprises acheteuses de services en nuage, en pourcentage, 2025

Messagerie.texte: some 85.15% relied on a cloud solution for their e-mail

Bureautique.texte: used it for office software (e.g. word processors, spreadsheets) (71.69%)

Comptabilité et finance.texte: more sophisticated end customer software applications, for finances/accounting (58.16%)

Gestion intégrée.texte: for planning their processes and resources (enterprise resource planning - ERP) (30.12%)

Relation client.texte: for managing information about their customers (customer relationship management CRM) (27.91%)
